breaking_news_suggestions.headline: Post-eclipse data is in: the dome's magnetic "hit" was already there before the eclipse started
breaking_news_suggestions.summary: Independent INTERMAGNET analysis of the 2026-08-12 eclipse shows the -13 to -19 nT deviations the dome would call a confirmed prediction were present up to 2 hours before first contact, tracking a storm-recovery ring-current offset. Once removed, the eclipse-attributable signal at every station is within about +/-5 nT of zero -- far short of the dome's own -17 to -21 nT (or -28.9 nT live-scoring) prediction.
